notes: attempt-1 was exploratory: it tabulated scene/condition coding and missingness in master.csv and printed no RESULT lines. The final run estimates Table 2 as pooled OLS linear probability models (fixest::feols) of Punishment (Violation and Violation+Help scenes) and Helping (Help and Violation+Help scenes) on Child, VH (ViolationHelp), and Child x VH, with School-clustered SEs (30 clusters). Columns 2 and 4 add the controls male (Male Target), hugo (Male Actor, inferred from coding; its coefficients match the paper), Morning, witness, rich, Rain and Hot. Listwise deletion drops the one observation with missing male in each sample, giving N = 400/399/401/400. Every coefficient, constant and R2 matches Table 2 at the reported precision. The first scored run is the final one, and the script was not changed after the comparison.
